crew.overview: Though Kevin has evidenced 23 personalities to his trusted psychiatrist, Dr. Fletcher, there remains one still submerged who is set to materialize and dominate all the others. Compelled to abduct three teenage girls led by the willful, observant Casey, Kevin reaches a war for survival among all of those contained within him — as well as everyone around him — as the walls between his compartments shatter apart.
crew.title: Split

details.biography: Ashwin Rajan is an American film producer and the President of Production at Blinding Edge Pictures. He is best known for producing "Glass" (2019), "Old" (2021), "Knock at the Cabin" (2023), "The Watchers" (2024) and "Trap" (2024). He also executive produced the television series "Wayward Pines" (2015) and "Servant" (2019).
details.name: Ashwin Rajan
